decision: Do not adopt A/B PDF text parsing parallelism in the product at this stage
limits: No Windows, low-memory, or beyond-20-page validation
Repeated pages are not diverse report inputs
Prototype full product regression not run; product tests use unchanged src
Font probe clears internal caches in a separate process, not an end-to-end PDF concurrency proof
Initial ArialMT font probe failed because PdfPig could not resolve that font; final probe uses verified Monaco and AppleSymbols
JIT, static initialization, and lock costs not individually attributed by CPU profiling
No release, push, or dependency changes
